paper.title: Volumetric Spanners: an Efficient Exploration Basis for Learning

settings.name_in_paper: Bandit Linear Optimization (BLO) over general convex sets
unmapped: loss vectors chosen from a convex set Z whose polar contains K, i.e. |L^T x| <= 1 for all x in K
settings.definition_quote: iteratively at each time sequence $t$, the environment chooses a loss vector $L_t$ that is not revealed to the player. The player chooses a vector $x_t \in \K$ where $\K \subseteq \reals^d$ is convex, and once she commits to her choice, the loss $\ell_t = x_t^\top L_t$ is revealed. ... The set $\K$ is equipped with a membership oracle. ... The losses are bounded in absolute values by 1. That is, the loss functions are always chosen (by an oblivious adversary) from a convex set $\cal Z$ such that $\K$ is contained in its polar

symbols.s: max_t |S_t|, maximal size of the exploration spanner set
symbols.N_net: |K|_{1/T}, size of a 1/T-net of K w.r.t. the norm induced by the loss set

conditions: |L_t^T x| <= 1 for all x in K

source.label: thm:geo hedge
source.quote: Under the assumptions stated above, and let $s=\max_t |S_t|$, $ \eta = \sqrt{\frac{\log |\K|_{1/T}}{dT}}$ and let $\gamma = s\sqrt{\frac{\log(|\K|_{1/T})}{dT}} $. Algorithm \ref{alg:BLO} given parameters $\gamma,\eta$ suffers a regret bounded by $$ O\left(  (s+d)\sqrt{\frac{T \log |\K|_{1/T} }{d}} \right)$$

results.notes: Regret in proof is E[sum L_t^T x_t] - sum L_t^T x* against oblivious adversary; recorded as pseudo-regret. Polynomial runtime per Corollary 7.2 (tilde O(d^5 + d^3 T^6) per iteration).

conditions: |L_t^T x| <= 1 for all x in K

source.quote: There exist an efficient algorithm for BLO for any convex set $\K$ with regret of $$ O\left(  \sqrt{dT \log |\K|_{1/T}  } \right) = O\left(  d\sqrt{T \log(T)  } \right) $$

results.notes: Follows from Theorem 7.1 with s = O(d).
